what: The storage-rent distinct-outputs rule (6.0.7 security soft fork) activates at the mainnet height constant StorageRentDistinctOutputsActivationHeight = 1885000 on every network (ergo-core ValidationRules.scala:275, checked in ErgoTransaction.validateStateful), so a devnet never activates it; a rent scenario on the rig runs the pre-fork rule.
workaround: none in config; needs a devnet-aware activation height in the node or a patched jar

what: A cached block candidate is regenerated on a mempool change only once it is older than ergo.node.blockCandidateGenerationInterval (default 60s), so a transaction valid for exactly one height never enters that height's candidate on a fast devnet.
ergo-appkit's NetworkType has no DEVNET, so a client built on it refuses a node whose /info reports network devnet.
workaround: rig/lib/appkit-proxy.py rewrites the /info field to testnet; the devnet uses testnet address prefixes

what: ergo.wallet.testMnemonic builds the node wallet from the root key and its direct children (ErgoWalletSupport.buildProverFromMnemonic), not the EIP-3 path a restored or keystore wallet uses, so a node and an application sharing a mnemonic do not share addresses.
workaround: topology conf "ergo.wallet.testMnemonic": "null", then /wallet/restore over the API with the application's mnemonic (rig/examples/lithos-block.sh)
